## Common WHERE Filters

### 标准全量查询 (最常用)
```sql
WHERE regional_date = DATE('${TODAY}')
  AND regional_hour = '${hour}'
  AND country IN ('ID','TH','PH','VN','MY','TW','SG')
  AND request_id IS NOT NULL
  AND user_id > 0
  AND ads_id > 0
  AND shop_id > 0
  AND item_type IS NOT NULL
  AND is_sampled = true
```

### DQC 数据质量检查
```sql
WHERE regional_date = DATE '${1_DAYS_AGO}'
  AND regional_hour = '00'
  AND country IN ('ID','TH','PH','VN','MY','TW','SG')
  AND item_type IN ('TARGET_ROI2', 'SIMPLE_ROI2')
  AND is_sampled = true
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

### JOIN exchange_rate (汇率换算)
```sql
LEFT JOIN mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live
  ON table.regional_date = exchange_info.grass_date
  AND table.country = exchange_info.grass_region
WHERE exchange_info.grass_region IN ('ID','PH','SG','TH','TW','MY','VN')
  AND exchange_info.grass_date = DATE('${TODAY}')
```
用途: 将 rank_item_price, pgmv 等本地货币字段换算为 USD。

## Common Aggregations

### 漏斗量级统计 (COUNT / SUM CASE WHEN)
```sql
COUNT(*) AS cnt,
SUM(CASE WHEN is_recall THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recall_num,
SUM(CASE WHEN recall_type IN (1,3) AND is_recall THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ads_recall_num,
SUM(CASE WHEN recall_type IN (2,3) AND is_recall THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS org_recall_num,
SUM(CASE WHEN is_prerank THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  + SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_prerank AND is_rank THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prerank_num,
SUM(CASE WHEN is_rank THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rank_num,
SUM(CASE WHEN is_mixrank THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mixrank_num,
SUM(CASE WHEN is_dispatch THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dispatch_num
```

### 漏斗请求级 (COUNT DISTINCT request_id)
```sql
COUNT(DISTINCT request_id) AS request_cnt,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (is_prerank OR (NOT is_prerank AND is_rank)) THEN request_id END)
  AS after_recall_num,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_rank THEN request_id END) AS after_prerank_num,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_mixrank THEN request_id END) AS after_rank_num,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_dispatch THEN request_id END) AS after_mixrank_num
```

### JSON Ext 字段解析 (ads_bid_ext)
```sql
CAST(get_json_object(ads_bid_ext, '$.pctr') AS DOUBLE) AS pctr,
CAST(get_json_object(ads_bid_ext, '$.pcr') AS DOUBLE) AS pcr,
CAST(get_json_object(ads_bid_ext, '$.broad_pcr') AS DOUBLE) AS broad_pcr,
CAST(get_json_object(ads_bid_ext, '$.target_cir') AS DOUBLE) AS target_cir,
CAST(get_json_object(ads_bid_ext, '$.rank_bid') AS DOUBLE) / 100000.0 AS rank_bid_price,
CAST(get_json_object(ads_bid_ext, '$.algo_ext.pgmv') AS DOUBLE) AS pgmv,
CAST(get_json_object(ads_bid_ext, '$.algo_ext.pid_coef') AS DOUBLE) AS pid_coef,
CAST(get_json_object(ads_bid_ext, '$.algo_ext.bid_coef_arr') AS VARCHAR) AS bid_coef_arr,
CAST(get_json_object(ads_bid_ext, '$.algo_ext.additional_deboost') AS DOUBLE) AS additional_deboost,
CAST(get_json_object(ads_bid_ext, '$.algo_ext.additional_boost') AS DOUBLE) AS additional_boost
```

### JSON Ext 字段解析 (ads_recall_ext / ads_info_ext)
```sql
-- recall ext (rcmd 专用)
CAST(get_json_object(ads_recall_ext, '$.prerank_score') AS DOUBLE) AS prerank_score,
CAST(get_json_object(ads_recall_ext, '$.lite_pctr') AS DOUBLE) AS lite_pctr,
CAST(get_json_object(ads_recall_ext, '$.lite_pcr') AS DOUBLE) AS lite_pcr,

CAST(get_json_object(ads_info_ext, '$.prerank_score') AS DOUBLE) AS prerank_score,
CAST(get_json_object(ads_info_ext, '$.item_price') AS DOUBLE) / 100000.0 AS rank_item_price,
CAST(get_json_object(ads_info_ext, '$.avg_sold_cnt_item') AS DOUBLE) AS avg_sold_count
```

### 场景分类 (entrance -> scene)
```sql
CASE
  WHEN entrance IN ('daily_discover_main') THEN 'dd'
  WHEN entrance IN ('product_detail_page') THEN 'ymal'
  WHEN entrance IN ('orderpaid_discover','shoppingcart','my_purchases_page_ymal',
                     'order_detail_page_ymal','me_page_ymal') THEN 'pp'
  ELSE 'other'
END AS scene
```

```sql
  WHEN item_type IN ('TARGET_ROI2') THEN 'roi2'
  WHEN item_type IN ('SIMPLE_ROI2') THEN 'simple_roi2'
  WHEN item_type IN ('ROI1') THEN 'manual'

END AS product_type
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### 1. 全链路小时指标聚合 (rcmd + search UNION ALL, 汇率换算)
```sql
SELECT
    item_id, ads_id, shop_id,
    CASE WHEN entrance IN ('daily_discover_main') THEN 'dd' ... END AS scene,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_recall THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recall_num,
    ...
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_rank THEN CAST(get_json_object(ads_bid_ext, '$.algo_ext.pgmv') AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      / 100000.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN ads_bid_ext IS NOT NULL AND is_rank THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pgmv,
    rank_item_price / CAST(exchange_rate AS DOUBLE) AS rank_item_price
FROM srdi_mart.dwd_sr_data_warehouse_rcmd_unify_full_link_log_1h
WHERE regional_date = DATE('${1_DAYS_AGO}')
  AND country IN ('ID','TH','PH','VN','MY','TW','SG')
  AND request_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id > 0 AND ads_id > 0 AND shop_id > 0
  AND item_type IS NOT NULL AND is_sampled = true
GROUP BY item_id, ads_id, shop_id, regional_date, country,
  CASE WHEN entrance IN ('daily_discover_main') THEN 'dd' ... END,
  CASE WHEN item_type IN ('TARGET_ROI2') THEN 'roi2' ... END
```

### 2. DQC 扩展字段填充率检查
```sql
WITH filter AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN is_recall = true AND recall_type = 1 AND item_type != 'ORGANIC'
             THEN ads_recall_ext ELSE NULL END AS ads_recall_ext,
        CASE WHEN is_prerank = true AND recall_type = 2 AND item_type != 'ORGANIC'
             THEN ads_info_ext ELSE NULL END AS ads_info_ext,
        CASE WHEN is_mixrank = true AND mixrank_remove_reason != 'MIXRANK_TRUNCATED'
             AND item_type != 'ORGANIC'
             THEN ads_bid_ext ELSE NULL END AS ads_bid_ext,
        CASE WHEN is_dispatch = true AND item_type != 'ORGANIC'
             THEN ads_deduct_ext ELSE NULL END AS ads_deduct_ext,
        country, regional_date, regional_hour
    FROM srdi_mart.dwd_sr_data_warehouse_rcmd_unify_full_link_log_1h
    WHERE regional_date = DATE '${1_DAYS_AGO}'
      AND regional_hour = '00'
      AND country IN ('ID','TH','PH','VN','MY','TW','SG')
      AND item_type IN ('TARGET_ROI2', 'SIMPLE_ROI2')
      AND is_sampled = true
)
SELECT country,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(json_extract_scalar(ads_bid_ext_json, '$.pctr') AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL
        AND CAST(json_extract_scalar(ads_bid_ext_json, '$.pctr') AS DOUBLE) != 0.0
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / MAX(bid_count), 2) AS bid_pctr_fill_rate
    -- ... 更多填充率指标 ...
FROM parsed p JOIN denominators d ON p.country = d.country
GROUP BY d.country, d.regional_date, d.regional_hour
```

### 3. 混排 pacing deboost 效果分析
```sql
WITH mix_rank_data AS (
    SELECT
        regional_date AS grass_date, country AS grass_region, regional_hour,
        request_id,
        IF(COALESCE(CAST(json_extract_scalar(json_parse(ads_bid_ext),
            '$.algo_ext.additional_deboost') AS DOUBLE), 0) < -1e-10, 1, 0) AS is_deboost,
        COALESCE(CAST(json_extract_scalar(ads_bid_ext, '$.rank_bid') AS DOUBLE)
            * mixrank_pctr, 0) AS ecpm,
        COALESCE(CAST(json_extract_scalar(json_parse(ads_bid_ext),
            '$.algo_ext.pgmv') AS DOUBLE), 0)
            * COALESCE(CAST(json_extract_scalar(json_parse(ads_bid_ext),
            '$.target_cir') AS DOUBLE), 0)
            * COALESCE(CAST(json_extract_scalar(json_parse(ads_bid_ext),
            '$.pctr') AS DOUBLE), 0) AS padvv,
        ads_id
    FROM srdi_mart.dwd_sr_data_warehouse_rcmd_unify_full_link_log_1h
    WHERE regional_date = DATE('2025-11-18')
      AND regional_hour IN ('01', '06', '09')
      AND country = 'TW'
      AND item_type != 'ORGANIC' AND item_type IS NOT NULL
      AND is_mixrank = true
)
SELECT grass_date, grass_region, regional_hour,
    is_deboost, IF(pacing_coef < 1.0000123, 1, 0) AS is_pacing,
    CASE WHEN padvv / avg_padvv < 0.1 THEN '<0.1' ... END AS padvv_ratio_bucket,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ads_id) AS ads_id_cnt,
    AVG(additional_deboost / ecpm) AS deboost_ratio
FROM mix_rank_data
GROUP BY grass_date, grass_region, regional_hour, is_deboost, is_pacing, ...
```

### 4. 全链路漏斗监控 (每日 ads-level)
```sql
SELECT
    ads_id, regional_date, country,
    CASE WHEN entrance IN ('daily_discover_main') THEN 'dd' ... END AS scene,
    COUNT(DISTINCT request_id) AS request_cnt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (is_prerank OR (NOT is_prerank AND is_rank))
        THEN request_id END) AS after_recall_num,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_rank THEN request_id END) AS after_prerank_num,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_mixrank THEN request_id END) AS after_rank_num,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_dispatch THEN request_id END) AS after_mixrank_num
FROM srdi_mart.dwd_sr_data_warehouse_rcmd_unify_full_link_log_1h
WHERE regional_date = DATE('${1_DAYS_AGO}')
  AND country IN ('SG')
  AND is_sampled = true
  AND request_id IS NOT NULL AND request_id != '' AND request_id != '0'
  AND ads_id > 0
GROUP BY ads_id, regional_date, country,
  CASE WHEN entrance IN ('daily_discover_main') THEN 'dd' ... END
```

### 6. Search + Rcmd UNION ALL 小时聚合 (产出 ads_full_hourly_metrics)
```sql
-- Search 部分
SELECT
    ads_real_item_id AS item_id, ads_id, shop_id, 'search' AS scene,
    CASE WHEN item_type IN ('TARGET_ROI2') THEN 'roi2' ... END AS product_type,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,

    -- 粗排分数从 ads_info_ext 提取 (search 特有)

        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(get_json_object(ads_info_ext, '$.prerank_score') AS DOUBLE) > 0 AND is_prerank THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 0.0) AS prerank_score,

WHERE regional_date = DATE('${TODAY}') AND regional_hour = '${hour}'
  AND country IN ('ID','TH','PH','VN','MY','TW','SG')
  AND request_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id > 0 AND ads_id > 0 AND shop_id > 0
  AND item_type IS NOT NULL AND is_sampled = true
GROUP BY ads_real_item_id, ads_id, shop_id, regional_date, country, regional_hour, ...

UNION ALL

-- Rcmd 部分
SELECT
    item_id, ads_id, shop_id,
    CASE WHEN entrance IN ('daily_discover_main') THEN 'dd' ... END AS scene,
    CASE WHEN item_type IN ('TARGET_ROI2') THEN 'roi2' ... END AS product_type,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    -- 粗排分数从 ads_recall_ext 提取 (rcmd 特有)
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_prerank THEN CAST(get_json_object(ads_recall_ext, '$.prerank_score') AS double) ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(get_json_object(ads_recall_ext, '$.prerank_score') AS DOUBLE) > 0 AND is_prerank THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 0.0) AS prerank_score,
    ...
FROM srdi_mart.dwd_sr_data_warehouse_rcmd_unify_full_link_log_1h
WHERE regional_date = DATE('${TODAY}') AND regional_hour = '${hour}'
  AND country IN ('ID','TH','PH','VN','MY','TW','SG')
  AND request_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id > 0 AND ads_id > 0 AND shop_id > 0
  AND item_type IS NOT NULL AND is_sampled = true
GROUP BY item_id, ads_id, shop_id, regional_date, country, regional_hour, ...
```

### 7. DQC ads_bid_ext 填充率检查 (json_extract_scalar 批量提取)
```sql
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(json_parse(ads_bid_ext) AS row(
            pctr double, pcr double, broad_pcr double,
            org_ecpm double, org_bid_price double, rank_bid double,
            target_cir double, user_blacklist boolean, shop_blacklist boolean
        )) AS bid_ext,
        country, regional_date, regional_hour
    FROM filter
)
SELECT country,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(json_extract_scalar(ads_bid_ext_json, '$.pctr') AS double) IS NOT NULL
        AND CAST(json_extract_scalar(ads_bid_ext_json, '$.pctr') AS double) != 0.0
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / MAX(bid_count), 2) AS bid_pctr_fill_rate,
    -- algo_ext 嵌套字段
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(json_extract_scalar(ads_bid_ext_json, '$.algo_ext.pid_coef') AS double) IS NOT NULL
        AND CAST(json_extract_scalar(ads_bid_ext_json, '$.algo_ext.pid_coef') AS double) != 0.0
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / MAX(bid_count), 2) AS bid_algo_pid_coef_fill_rate
FROM parsed
```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

| Metric | Formula | Occurrences |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| target_roi | 1.0 / target_cir | 10+ |
| padvv (rcmd) | rank_item_price * avg_sold_cnt_item * (0.3 * rank_pcr + 0.7 * rank_broad_pcr) * pid_coef * target_cir / 100000.0 | 5+ |
| padvv (search) | pgmv * target_cir / 100000.0 | 5+ |
| ecpm | rank_bid * pctr | 3+ |
| pgmv (per-rank normalized) | pgmv / 100000.0 / COUNT(is_rank) | 5+ |
| rank_item_price (USD) | rank_item_price / exchange_rate | 5+ |
| prerank_bidprice | prerank_bid / 100000.0 | 5+ |
| rank_bid_price | rank_bid / 100000.0 | 5+ |
| deduction_price | deduction_price / 100000.0 | 3+ |
| deboost_ratio | additional_deboost / ecpm | 2 |
| mixrank_target_roi | 1.0 / target_cir (仅 WHERE is_mixrank=true) | 3+ |
